identity.title: Add evidence-backed budget snapshots without billing or payment infrastructure

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Represent explicit budget/usage facts as source-neutral records: subject/scope, unit, optional limit, consumed, remaining, native status and evidence refs. Emit budget_exceeded / budget_unknown only when justified. Do not add Stripe, invoices, pricing plans or accounting ledgers. Dependency: 8044.project-approval-evidence.
human_pressure.why_now: Budget is a governance constraint ('how much may this invocation/workflow spend?'), not a transport monetization feature. The safe next step is evidence projection, not billing infrastructure.
do_not_misread: This repository is the canonical Ailuros governance runtime; do not apply cleanup assumptions from the legacy MCP Gateway repository.
Identity references are governance provenance, not login/authentication/session management.
Approval and budget in this batch are evidence-backed records/projections, not workflow/payment services.
Do not turn Ailuros into an agent executor or coding harness.

machine_core.goal: Add deterministic budget evidence projection and bounded governance signals.
invariants: Depends on: 8044.project-approval-evidence. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
Budget facts are orthogonal to execution success.
Budget projection is derived/read-side and rebuildable.
contracts: BudgetRecord preserves native values/status and evidence refs.
failure_semantics: Missing governance-context evidence remains unknown/absent; it is never inferred as allowed, approved, within budget or clean.
Explicit denial/violation evidence is preserved with evidence refs.
Derived control-context state remains rebuildable from immutable evidence.
Producer-native values remain preserved alongside normalized projections.

steps.title: Define minimal BudgetRecord
details: subject/scope ref, unit (currency/tokens/requests/producer-defined), optional limit/consumed/remaining, native status, evidence refs.
Do not assume EUR/USD or monetary billing; units remain explicit.

steps.title: Project explicit values
details: Use producer-provided measured/declared budget evidence only.
Do not estimate token cost, model price or remaining budget without explicit evidence.

steps.title: Emit bounded signals
details: budget_exceeded requires explicit exceeded evidence or deterministic consumed > explicit limit using compatible units.
budget_unknown only when evidence explicitly establishes that a required budget evaluation exists but values/status are insufficient.

steps.title: Keep billing out
details: No payment provider, subscription, invoice, pricing table, wallet or transport-charge concept.
Tests cover monetary and non-monetary units.

acceptance: Budget records are evidence-backed and unit-explicit.
No cost is guessed from vendor/model pricing.
budget_exceeded cannot arise from incompatible/missing units.
validate: python -m ruff check src/ailuros/core/execution.py src/ailuros/projection.py src/ailuros/signals.py tests/test_budget_governance.py

must_check: Budget governance is separate from monetization.
All calculations use explicit compatible units.
No vendor pricing lookup is introduced.
reject_if: Model pricing is fetched or hardcoded to estimate cost.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed/approved/within-budget.
